title: Score history
hints: A single running total per player can't answer "what was it at time t?". Keep each player's history: the timestamps of their changes and the running total right after each one.
Because timestamps never go backwards, each player's timestamp list is already sorted. Appending keeps it sorted for free — and sorted lists mean you can binary search.
`bisect_right(times, at)` returns how many changes happened at or before `at`. If that count is `i > 0`, the answer is `totals[i - 1]`; if it's `0`, the player had no changes yet.

Make the untimed `add_score` call `add_score_at(player, points, self.latest)` so there is exactly one code path that records changes. Then `get_score` is just the last running total, and `top`/`top_at` can share one sort-and-format helper.
